edit.description: a mention option rendering the target's projection path relative to the host's
resolve the path display at emit via relativeProjection; refuse a target that projects no file

summary: a mention can render as the target's projection path relative to the host, so a router's link to a supporting doc is one bound spelling, not a hand-written path
acceptance: a skill body mentioning its supporting doc in path form emits the doc's path relative to SKILL.md; a path-form mention of a member projecting no file refuses before any write
notes: One fact, one spelling: a hand-written link is an unbound restatement of the target's placement. relativeProjection already derives EdgeTargetFacts.path for render hooks — reuse it. Option spelling is build's call (e.g. mentionOf(doc, { as: "path" })). SDK-gate behavior, so no tests[] line.
